profile.headline: Sr. Staff Software Engineer @UPMC Enterprises | Test Architecture | Technical Leader
profile.summary:
Experienced leader with a strong background in delivering effective solutions and processes for test automation and performance testing, with a passion for hands-on research and the implementation of emerging technologies. Recognized for reliability, adaptability, and providing hands-on leadership that drives team success and ensures the delivery of high-quality software solutions.

At UPMC Enterprises, I have led efforts to leverage Amazon Web Services (AWS) and k6 Load Testing to optimize our software solutions. My expertise in these areas has played a key role in enhancing our team's focus on quality and performance.

During my tenure at UPMC, I have made significant contributions to functional test automation and performance testing for the MyUPMC patient portal, spanning Web, iOS, and Android platforms.

I consistently led the test strategy and execution of rapid, efficient functional and non-functional test automation for production-ready MVP projects within the innovation team. This approach has ensured the successful and timely launch of new products and solutions, aligned with organizational leadership's goals.

Additionally, I provided technical leadership for implementing and maintaining automated tests for various non-patient-facing applications at UPMC, including integrations with vendor systems, helping to drive the overall quality of enterprise solutions.

positions.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Test Architect in the Architecture and Site Reliability team for the MyUPMC program, key responsibilities and accomplishments include:

Technical Leadership and guidance: Direct a team of high-performing test engineers, providing technical leadership across cross-platform feature teams for Web, iOS, and Android functional test automation, performance testing, integration testing and other non-functional verification.

Test Automation & Hands-On Contributions: Contributed to automated functional testing for web (using Playwright and Protractor) and native mobile platforms (iOS and Android). Led backend and web framework upgrades, improving automation, performance verification, and testing.

Performance Testing & CI/CD Integration: Spearheaded the integration of K6 (an open-source performance testing tool) into the CI/CD pipelines. 

Cost Reduction & App Performance: Actively worked with devOps/architects to verify performance improving and cost reduction solutions for AWS (EKS, EC2, RDS) hosted applications and services.
Reduced cloud costs (e.g., AWS) by 15% by helping architecture team thoroughly test and verify EKS management strategies like spot instances, native images and autoscaling.

Promotion of Open-Source Tools: Advocated for the use of open-source tools for test automation, reporting, and CI integration, enhancing efficiency across teams.

Cloud Management: Focused on maintaining a lean cloud footprint, managing performance test coverage for micro-services, and overseeing system-level tests for a multi-team agile development program.

Issue Resolutions: Investigated and triaged functional and performance issues in production, ensuring rapid resolution and smooth release. 

Led testing for AWS Lambda-based multi-channel outreach campaign manager.

This role combines leadership, technical expertise, and a focus on performance optimization, test automation, and cost efficiency within a cloud-based, agile development environment.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer - Lead
positions.description:
- Develop and implement test strategies and open-source test automation frameworks for multiple teams.
- Lead the performance testing group, promoting best practices, documenting procedures, and resolving technical challenges faced by teams.
- Spearhead performance and security testing initiatives for both internal and external-facing applications and services.
- Partner closely with the QA manager to adapt to strategic changes within the enterprise QA department and implement effective solutions and processes.
- Research, evaluate, and introduce new tools for test management, CI/CD, and security testing, while also conducting cross-team code reviews and providing training and mentorship to test engineers.

positions.title: Lead, Test Automation and Performance
positions.description:
- Leading test automation and performance testing activities for all applications of Direct Energy Business division. 
- Developed a test automation and performance testing strategy outlining major milestones and timelines for the test automation initiatives, detailed analysis of web based test automation and mobile test automation tools, technical solutions, framework design and guidelines.
- Developed and implemented test automation framework using QTP to support applications using different technologies. Used extensibility SDK to extend support of QTP for Teleriks Kendo controls. 
- Designed, developed and analyzed performance tests for multiple applications using LoadRunner and Visual studio.
- Provided detailed analysis and execution reports for performance tests and helped identify root cause for existing/probable performance issues/bottlenecks.
- Leveraged domain knowledge of existing onsite test team and onboarded new offshore automation resources to accomplish quick and effective automation of various regression test suites and increasing coverage of performance test suite.

positions.title: Sr. Software Performance Analyst
positions.description: Developed and maintained suite of performance tests which provided complete coverage of all critical  functionality. Maintained performance baslines for individual web services. Comparing performance test results to baseline results and pointing out potential concerns/improvements for each ongoing release and re-base lining as necessary. Identified and assisted in fixing critical performance issues by working closely with architecture and development teams.

positions.title: Sr. Automation Specialist
positions.description:
Developed and implemented a mobile test automation framework to automate regression test suites of mobile applications running on FedEx's handheld scanners. Reduced the regression test cycle times from 2 weeks to 2-3 days.
Implemented the framework with configuration capability to enable automation of various models of handheld devices.
Helped design excel vba based data entry User interface for the automation framework to enable manual testers to convert the manual test suites into automated tests with minimal effort and technical know how.

positions.title: Automation Lead
positions.description: Developed and implemented test automation framework and automated testing for the  MISMO mandate implementation of Fannie Mae. Integrated automation framework to the Business Process Testing module of QTP to enable business and quality analysts to utilize test automation round the clock, on demand and expedite verification and validation process and identify possible issues earlier in the development cycle.

positions.title: QA Lead
positions.description: Worked as QA Lead for Client Integrations project which involved verification and validation of key client EDI interfaces of Servicelink. Managed quality assurance of new integration framework and configuration tool which were developed ground up to handle existing and new client interfaces.Co-ordinated testing efforts with the clients to ensure the interfaces are certified and meet clients expctations prior to production release and ensure event free roll outs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a Senior Software Engineer at Patni on Quality Assurance for Statefarm Insurance projects like ECRM, statefarm website, CIMS-CPTS.
Developed keyword driven test automation framework for Web and client server based applications to be implemented across different projects involving extensive testing efforts.
Audited various projects working as an Internal Quality auditor, verifying adherence to Quality management system of Patni which followed CMMI - 5 guidelines.

educations.schoolName: Symbiosis Institute of Computer Studies and Research
